fieldValues.title: editorHint was silently dropped in this repository's own package
fieldValues.summary: The programme package's own `title` field is authored editorHint: singleline, but the pinned CLI's type schema projected x-srs-widget: textarea for it anyway — confirming srs-rust#958's report was live in this repository, not hypothetical.
evidence: srs field get --repo programme c42d4a91-dbd9-480a-b612-e31b5a77d9bf shows fieldType.format=plain and editorHint=singleline

srs type schema --repo programme <unit|finding|carried_context typeId> (pinned CLI, pre-fix) emits properties.title["x-srs-widget"]="textarea" for every one of the three types authored against this same title field
srs-rust PR #975 fixes this in type_schema_service::apply_editor_hint_widget; the pinned CLI installed in this session predates that PR
